question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

A person who speaks two languages
solution:
The correct answer is '**Bilingual**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• **Bilateral** - **involving two groups of people or two countries**. (दो देशों अथवा दो समूहों की संलिप्तता; द्विपक्षीय, दुतरफ़ा)
 
• Bilingual - **able to speak two languages equally well**. (द्विभाषी, दो भाषाओं को अच्‍छी तरह बोलने में समर्थ)
 
• **Multilingual** - **written or printed in several languages**. (अनेक भाषाओं में लिखित या मुद्रित; बहुभाषी, बहुभाषीय, बहुभाषिक)
 
• **Monolingual** - **using only one language**. (जिसमें केवल एक भाषा का प्रयोग हो; एकभाषिक)

 ​
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
